selection: First four stored rows, fixed before inference; smoke/regression only, not the full benchmark
license_review: Pinned README front matter lists Apache-2.0; trailing block lists CDLA-Permissive-2.0. Conflicting metadata unresolved. No dataset redistribution or training approval.
preprocessing: Unchanged supplied GroundTruthPageImages PNG; all native tiles; not PDF rasterization timing
scoring: Strict native Markdown versus pinned docling-core ground-truth Markdown, all content layers; whitespace collapse only. Missing/blocked Markdown scores as empty. CER/WER include markup and are not plain-text OCR metrics. Table cell text uses whitespace normalization with exact grid positions/spans, table order, and counts.
failure_policy: Retain every selected case, raw output, IDs, stop reason and diagnostics. No retries based on quality, output repair, or exclusion of long/unsupported pages. Runtime errors remain failures.
raw_text_diagnostic: Compare whitespace-normalized tag-stripped raw generation against pinned Docling plain-text export, all layers. Diagnostic only; does not turn blocked Markdown into a successful conversion or establish semantic/math equivalence.
